notes.title: NEW BEATBUDDY GAME, BUNDLES & SOUNDTRACK!
notes.content:
[h1] Hey Beatbuddies[/h1]

To celebrate the release of the all new [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/412970/]Beatbuddy: On Tour[/url]
we've finally released the original Beatbuddy: Tale of the Guardians [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/257310/]Soundtrack on Steam![/url]
If you want to go ALL IN you can check out the new [url=http://store.steampowered.com/sub/87158/]ULTIMATE BUNDLE[/url]
containing [b]both Beatbuddy Games, 2 Soundtracks and 3 playable prototypes[/b] evolved during the crazy development ride which started back in 2009. Get the tour started and let us know what you think about Beatbuddy's new gig.

We wish you a merry Christmas and thank everyone for all the great support!
[b]The Threaks[/b]

notes.content:

[list]
    [*]All New Touch Controls
    [*]Polished Mouse Controls
    [*]New Russian Language Support
    [*]New Menu Design
    [*]Link To New Merch-Store Hitting You In The Next Few Days

If you like to follow us please check out [url=www.beatbuddy.com]www.beatbuddy.com![/url]
[b]THANK YOU![/b]

notes.title: Epic Patch with all new Mouse controls
notes.content:
The new Beatbuddy patch is here!

As a highlight we bring you brand new mouse controls. We completely refurbished the input and are super happy with the results! We also added a new menu song and made major improvements on the performance of the game, it should now run way smoother also on lower end machines. Of course we also fixed a lot of small and not so small Bugs.
This is what we call a patch! Hope you like it :)

notes.title: Patch Notes
notes.content:
We just released the second patch which includes the following:

- fixed more "level not visible" bugs
- fixed some tutorial messages not being displayed
- fixed a few more issues with the falling stones in Ruins
- fixed soldier spikes clipping through pipes
- fixed extras being cut off
- fixed some fixed snareplugs behaving strange
- fix for being able to open/close the pause menu too fast, stopping everything
- fixed keyboard warning not being shown long enough when starting new game
- fixed mouse indicator object behaving strange when player gets rotated
- made a lot of improvements to reduce lag/freezing
- a lot of bugfixes too small to list here

notes.title: Patch Notes
notes.content:
Here are the changes from the latest patch:

- fix wrong savegames/data when using Beatbuddy on multiple computers
- fix being able to get stuck in Ruins part 4
- fix various Snareplug problems
- fix the "In" not always sucking in Player correctly
- fix Soundsources respawning although they were already used
- fix for Spikes not killing player sometimes
- fix Intro/Outro Video cut off
- made some improvements to reduce lag/freezing throughout the game, especially when reaching checkpoints
- a lot of bugfixes too small to list here
